power.poluten.blindness.name: Shadow Veil
power.poluten.blindness.description: Leaving blocks in shadow form gives you Blindness for 2 seconds.
power.poluten.fall.name: No Legs
power.poluten.fall.description: You take no fall damage in shadow form.
power.poluten.fire.name: Light Burns the Shadow
power.poluten.fire.description: You take twice as much damage from fire and lava.
power.poluten.health.name: Half Dead
power.poluten.last_breath.name: Last Breath
power.poluten.last_breath.description: Lethal damage forces you into shadow form with 3.5 hearts, Strength II and Speed I. You can still be killed. After 10 seconds, you die regardless. Hunger cannot end this form.
power.poluten.night.name: Night Wind
power.poluten.night.description: You gain Speed I at night.
power.poluten.poison.name: Shadow Venom
power.poluten.poison.description: A sword hit in shadow form inflicts Wither I for 3 seconds. The cooldown is 6 seconds, shared across all targets.
power.poluten.stomach.name: No Stomach
power.poluten.stomach.description: You cannot eat or drink in shadow form.
power.poluten.totem.name: No Pure Soul
power.poluten.totem.description: Totems of Undying cannot save you.
power.poluten.transform.name: Shadow Form
power.poluten.transform.description: Use your primary ability to pass through walls. Exhaustion increases fivefold and sunlight burns you. You cannot use items, interact with blocks or break them. You can only attack with a sword while outside blocks. You cannot leave shadow form inside blocks, except when your hunger reaches 6 points (3 food icons) and forces you out. The vignette turns red at 10 hunger points (5 food icons).
origin.poluten.poluten.name: Halfshade
origin.poluten.poluten.description: A great warrior who sought to defeat the darkness fell in the final battle and became half human, half shadow.
message.poluten.inside_blocks: You cannot leave shadow form inside blocks.
